chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Yazīd, from Ismā‘īl ibn Abī Ziyād, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abā Ja‘far عليه السلام say:
“Luqmān said to his son: Prolonged sitting at the place of relieving oneself causes hemorrhoids, so this was written on the door of the latrine.”

key_terms.لُقْمَانُ: Luqmān, the wise figure whose counsel is being quoted

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about sitting too long in the toilet?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits practical advice attributed to Luqmān regarding etiquette and bodily well-being. It discourages prolonged sitting in the place of relieving oneself, presenting this as wisdom significant enough to be publicly posted as a reminder.
